title: Generate image: coders at a Solana hackathon in Hong Kong
description:
Need one strong hero-style image showing coders working at a Solana hackathon in Hong Kong.

Requirements:
- Scene should feel modern, energetic, and clearly hackathon-focused
- Include multiple coders working on laptops
- Subtle Solana branding / vibe is welcome, but do not make it look cluttered
- Hong Kong atmosphere should be visible, for example skyline, neon, or venue cues
- Final image should be polished and suitable for social/media promo use

Deliverables:
- 1 final image
- Short note on prompt/style used
- If possible, include 1 alternate variation

Reward: 5 WAGE
